nodes.description: Public stake duration state variable, extended by extrendStakeDuration.
Total amount currently staked, incremented in stake and decremented in unstake.
ERC20 token used for staking and reward payouts.
ERC20 reward token reference set in the constructor but never used for payouts.
Mapping of address to Staker struct holding start, staked, earned and period.
Total reward pool used by _rewardsPerDay to compute emissions.
Fixed total supply constant declared but not used in staking math.
External stake function that registers or tops up a staker and pulls tokens via transferFrom.
External claim function paying accumulated rewards with stakingToken.transfer and resetting start.
External unstake function returning principal plus reward, then deletes the staker record.
View function combining currently earned and previously stored rewards for a staker.
Private reward computation using block.timestamp, share percentage and daily rewards.
Private helper computing the staker's share of totalStaked scaled by 1e9.
Private helper dividing the total reward pool by the staker period in days.
Private helper converting the staker period from seconds to days.
View function checking whether an address has an active staker record.
View function returning the staked amount for a given address.
Owner-only function raising the global staking duration.
Owner-only function draining an arbitrary ERC20 balance held by the contract.
Owner-only ownership transfer function delegating to _transferOwnership.
Owner-only function renouncing ownership to the zero address.
Internal ownership update emitting OwnershipTransferred.
View function returning the stored owner address.
Context helper returning the raw msg.sender value.
Caller-controlled address used as staker identity and as the privileged owner identity.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving staking start times and reward accrual.
ER-based external transfer to msg.sender inside unstake performed before deleting the staker record.
stakingToken.transfer to msg.sender inside claim before the earned balance is reset.
stakingToken.transfer of principal plus reward inside unstake, reachable before state deletion.
Arbitrary token.transfer drain in emergencyWithdrawToken controlled by the owner.
Arithmetic state mutation totalStaked -= _stakers[msg.sender].staked in unstake.
Chained multiplication and division producing the earned reward value in _userEarned.
Amount of staking tokens supplied by the caller to stake.
New staking duration supplied by the owner to extrendStakeDuration.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Address queried by isStaking.
Staker address argument used across userStaked, userEarnedTotal and the private reward helpers.
Arbitrary ERC20 token address passed to emergencyWithdrawToken.
Local variable holding the reward amount computed in claim.
Local variable holding the reward amount computed in unstake.
Local variable for elapsed staking seconds derived from block.timestamp.
Local variable accumulating the computed reward in _userEarned.
Local variable for the per-second emission rate.
Local variable holding the staker's scaled share of totalStaked.
Local variable holding the staker period converted to days.
Local variable holding the daily reward allocation.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which staker record is created or updated in stake.
msg.sender selects the staker whose rewards are claimed.
msg.sender selects the staker record deleted in unstake.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() to _msgSender() before allowing the duration change.
onlyOwner modifier gates the emergency token drain on msg.sender identity.
onlyOwner modifier gates ownership transfer on msg.sender identity.
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender identity.
owner() resolves the stored owner whose value originated from _msgSender().
stake records the caller-dependent block.timestamp as the staking start.
_userEarned derives secondsStaked directly from block.timestamp.
claim resets the staker start time to the current block.timestamp.
unstake reward payout depends on block.timestamp through userEarnedTotal.
stake increments totalStaked by the staked amount.
stake writes the Staker struct into the _stakers mapping.
stake branches on isStaking(msg.sender).
stake invokes _userEarned to credit prior rewards before resetting start.
stake triggers the external ERC20 pull call.
stake uses the stakingToken reference for the transferFrom pull.
claim calls userEarnedTotal to compute the payout.
claim performs the external token transfer before resetting the earned balance.
claim updates the stored start and earned fields of the staker.
claim requires isStaking(msg.sender) to be true.
unstake calls userEarnedTotal to compute the payout.
unstake transfers principal plus reward before deleting the staker record.
unstake reduces totalStaked by the unstaked amount.
unstake deletes the caller record from the _stakers mapping.
unstake performs the totalStaked subtraction over recorded stake.
unstake requires isStaking(msg.sender) to be true.
A malicious token transfer hook could re-enter unstake before _stakers is deleted.
A malicious token transfer hook could re-enter claim before the earned balance is zeroed.
userEarnedTotal delegates the current accrual computation to _userEarned.
_userEarned calls _sharePercentage for the staker share.
_userEarned calls _rewardsPerDay for the daily emission.
_sharePercentage reads the staker's staked amount from _stakers.
_sharePercentage divides by totalStaked, allowing a zero divisor path.
_rewardsPerDay calls _periodInDays to size the emission window.
_rewardsPerDay divides the _totalRewards pool by the period.
_periodInDays reads the staker period from _stakers.
isStaking reads the staker address field from _stakers.
userStaked reads the staked field from _stakers.
userEarnedTotal reads the previously earned amount using msg.sender rather than the staker argument.
extrendStakeDuration writes the new value into stakeDuration.
transferOwnership delegates the owner update to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership delegates the owner update to _transferOwnership with address(0).
owner comparison inside onlyOwner relies on _msgSender for the caller identity.
emergencyWithdrawToken performs the arbitrary token transfer drain.
The stakingToken reference is the target of the transferFrom call in stake.
The stakingToken reference is the target of the transfer call in claim.
The stakingToken reference is the target of the transfer call in unstake.
stakeAmount feeds the unchecked-style increment of staked and totalStaked inside stake.
duration is validated and written to stakeDuration.
newOwner flows from transferOwnership into the ownership update.
stakerAddr is compared against the stored staker field in isStaking.
The staker argument is passed to the accrual computation in userEarnedTotal.
The staker argument keys all reward math inside _userEarned.
The staker argument selects the balance used in _sharePercentage.
The staker argument selects the period read in _periodInDays.
The staker argument determines the emission period in _rewardsPerDay.
The token argument determines which asset is drained by emergencyWithdrawToken.
The return value of userEarnedTotal is stored into the claim reward local.
The computed reward local is the amount passed to the transfer in claim.
The return value of userEarnedTotal is stored into the unstake reward local.
The computed reward local is added to principal for the unstake transfer.
secondsStaked multiplies into the earned accumulator.
The earned value results from the chained multiply and divide flagged as arithmetic risk.
rewardsPerSec multiplies into the earned accumulator.
stakerSharePercentage multiplies into the earned accumulator.
periodInDays is the divisor producing rewardPerDay.
The return of _rewardsPerDay is stored into the rewardPerDay local.

normalization_plan.reason: The caller-supplied stake amount only exists to mutate staker and totalStaked state inside stake.
The duration argument is validated and folded into the stakeDuration write in the owner function.
The new owner argument has no meaning outside the ownership transfer function.
The queried address is only used to read the _stakers membership flag in isStaking.
The staker address argument exists solely to key the reward computation performed by _userEarned.
The token argument only selects the asset transferred by the owner-only drain function.
The claim reward local is consumed directly as the amount of the external transfer.
The unstake reward local is consumed directly by the principal-plus-reward transfer.
secondsStaked is a transient intermediate of the timestamp-dependent accrual in _userEarned.
The earned local is the direct result of the chained arithmetic expression flagged as an unsafe operation.
rewardsPerSec is only an intermediate divisor result inside _userEarned.
The share percentage local is the return of _sharePercentage before being multiplied into earned.
periodInDays is the return of _periodInDays and has no independent role.
rewardPerDay is the return of _rewardsPerDay feeding the accrual computation.
